_comment: Single source of truth for normalization enums. Read by scripts/backfill (Python) and workers/* (JS). Any raw string not covered by a map is a schema-assertion failure: the parser must raise, never guess.

method._note: UFC Stats prints the method as a two-line cell on event pages (e.g. 'KO/TKO' + 'Punches') and as 'Method: KO/TKO' on fight pages. Only the first token is mapped; the second line goes to finish_detail. Draw/NC are flagged by the W/L column ('draw' / 'nc'), not by the method string, so the parser must consult both.

weight_class._note: Raw strings look like 'Women's Strawweight Bout', 'UFC Lightweight Title Bout', 'UFC Interim Heavyweight Title Bout', 'Catch Weight Bout', 'Open Weight Bout', 'Ultimate Fighter 1 Middleweight Tournament Title Bout', 'Ultimate Fighter Latin America Featherweight Tournament Title Bout'. Normalise by: detect Women's -> is_womens; detect Title -> is_title; strip strip_tokens, digits, and region words; the remainder must be a key in map.

scheduled_rounds._note: From the fight page 'Time format' line. '3 Rnd (5-5-5)' -> 3; '5 Rnd (5-5-5-5-5)' -> 5; '1 Rnd + OT (12-3)' -> 1; '2 Rnd + 2OT (5-5-3-3)' -> 2; 'No Time Limit' -> null; 'Unlimited Rnd (10-10-...)' -> null. Regex: ^(\d+)\s*Rnd. Anything that neither matches the regex nor is in null_values is an assertion failure.

result_flags._note: The W/L column on event and fight pages.
